title: Chapter 338: The Spirit God Arrives
content:
Chapter 338: The Spirit God Arrives

During the period of large-scale fighting between the local camp and the evil god camp, the various races in the local camp continued to visit Wu Qing privately.

Wu Qing had limited time and could not meet with them one by one in person, so the Queen of Insects arranged and organized several unified meetings.

The status of the Zerg race is different now. Wu Qing has become the most distinguished person in the world, and ordinary people are not qualified to visit him at all.

Most of the races that visited Wu Qing just wanted to enhance their feelings and get familiar with each other.

Only a few super tribes provided Wu Qing with some secret intelligence.

Among them, the local human race brought Wu Qing some extremely important information.

There are local human races and alien human races in this world, which shows that the distribution of human races in this great universe world is very wide.

The local human race also had some origins with the outside human race in history.

In the inheritance of the local human race, a lot of information outside this world is recorded.

After the local human race saw the various technological equipment of the God race, they thought of the outside human race recorded in the tribe. Some branches of the human race relied on powerful technological equipment to travel across the world.

The local human race came to visit Wu Qing just to confirm whether Wu Qing was a human from the outside world.

When Wu Qing learned that there were other human races with technological civilization outside this world, he had a detailed exchange with the local human race. He wanted to know whether the world he lived in before crossing over was still in this big universe world.

The local human race did not hide anything, and copied all the relevant information passed down in the tribe and gave it to Wu Qing.

Wu Qing learned a little about the situation of the outside human race from these materials.

There are some human worlds in the outside world that are similar to the world Wu Qing lived in before crossing over, which gave Wu Qing a glimmer of hope.

In order to continue to obtain more information about the outside world, Wu Qing sent the dark archon of the gods to control the minds of many powerful people who had just been thrown into this world by the evil gods from outer space.

It's a pity that the powerful people of various races sent by these evil gods basically live in a closed world similar to this world, and the situation they know is not much different from the natives of this world.

But by sorting out this information, Wu Qing has a new goal, to solve the problems of this world as soon as possible, go to the outside world, and find the world before he crossed over.

Wu Qing didn't know what the original world looked like now, and he wanted to go back to see it. His parents and relatives were there, and it was his obsession.

...

With a specific new goal, the Zerg and Protoss under Wu Qing fought more actively.

Wu Qing no longer deliberately left space transmission channels to the outside world in order to eliminate more foreign strongmen. He once again personally destroyed the space transmission channels to the outside world opened by the sacrifices of the evil god camp.

When the last space transmission channel to the outside world was destroyed by Wu Qing, it marked that the powerful means of the evil god camp had completely failed.

Without the continuous support of the outside world, the Zerg and Protoss once again led the local camp to launch a fierce counterattack against the evil god camp.

On all fronts, the Zerg and Protoss joint army was unstoppable and killed into the heart of the evil god camp.

Countless evil god believers were killed, and the foundations of various foreign evil gods in this world were shaken.

Some of the main believing races of foreign evil gods took out the ultimate trump card, sacrificed their entire clan, and ushered in the evil god to come!

The first one to come was the first evil god camp race that Wu Qing encountered, the bear goblin tribe, the belief race of the spirit god!

Because of the Zerg, the spirit god had long been dissatisfied with the bear goblin tribe. At this moment, the spirit god first took the bear goblin tribe as an attack.

The bear goblin tribe, a once powerful race, under the oracle of the spirit god, all men, women, young and old, regardless of strength and identity, performed a terrible sacrifice under the guidance of the host of the sacrifice!

Countless white lights fell in the area where the entire bear goblin tribe lived, pulling the souls of every fanatical believer of the bear goblin tribe and flying to the sky!

At this moment, countless bear goblin tribe members instantly disappeared and died in the flesh!

Such a terrible sacrifice made the sacrifice area seem to have become the kingdom of the spirit god, and the rules and will of this world could not enter it!

The spirit god, who had once met Wu Qing, successfully brought down his power through the sacrifices of countless fanatical believers!

The power brought down by the spirit god made the super powerful people of the eleven-star level in this world aware of the huge danger!

"The cultivation system in the outside world is indeed more comprehensive and perfect. This power is almost invincible in this world!"

"What a pity. Now that I and the Queen of Insects are here, it's too late for you to take action!"

Wu Qing has arrived at the area where the spirit god descended. He stood alone in the air, staring at the mysterious figure shrouded in countless white light.

"You are a variable! I should have forced my move at that time!"

The mysterious figure spoke in a very neutral voice, and all the creatures in the world could hear his voice.

If it weren't for the full protection of the will of the world's rules, I don't know how many creatures would become believers of the spirit god just based on this sentence!

"It's just a creature with stronger cultivation, but it's really arrogant to call itself a god!"

"If you had forced your move at that time, it wouldn't be you who appeared here now!"

Wu Qing responded calmly.

"Hahaha! It seems that you are not a creature in this world either!"

"God is just a name, why care so much?"

"The origin of this world is strong, but it is almost gone. As long as you don't interfere in our affairs, we can turn enemies into friends!"

"How about I take you out now?"

"When the time comes, you will also be counted as one of the benefits of this world!"

The spirit god seemed to have seen Wu Qing's powerful strength and did not act immediately, but tried to persuade Wu Qing to give up interfering in the affairs of this world.

The words of the spirit god were deliberately heard by all the creatures in the world, which made the strong men of various races in the local camp secretly sweat.

If Wu Qing led the Zerg and Protoss to turn against him, this world would be finished immediately!

Many people have doubted the identities of Wu Qing and the Zerg and Protoss, but Wu Qing and the Zerg and Protoss rose too fast in this world, and they developed on the corpses of the evil god camp.

In the end, Wu Qing, the Zerg, and the Protoss were recognized by the will of the world rules, which left all those who doubted him speechless.

No matter what the identities of Wu Qing, the Zerg, and the Protoss were, what they did was beneficial to this world and the local camp, and that was enough.

If they continued to offend Wu Qing, the Zerg, and the Protoss without knowing the severity of the situation, it would only push this world and the local camp into the abyss of destruction.

Therefore, everyone deliberately ignored the identity issues of Wu Qing, the Zerg, and the Protoss.

Now that the Spirit God has spoken out this issue in front of everyone, and has not forgotten the past and has won over Wu Qing to divide the world, this has to make people worry.
